title: Date-based append-only periods with evidence-gated canonical promotion
context: Owner requires that proposals not overwrite history. Each idea is associated with its actual introduction date and an explicit version.
decision: Store unimplemented features as independent YYYY-MM-DD named, versioned packages under features/not-implemented. Future changes use additive dated amendments with amends/supersedes references; preserve older documents. After staging and production-value verification, append accepted capability/invariant references to the existing forever/manifest.json with evidence; never replace earlier records merely because a new period exists. Promote verified subsets only.
rationale: Retains why/what/when/where/how, respects historical provenance, prevents aspirations being misrepresented as working features and lets a cold agent trace evolution.
